reason: A gives me what I check before pledging: a delivery date, a refund if the game is more than three months late, updates every two weeks, and the admission that most of the 8.1 ratings came from people who played at the creator's own convention table. B has a useful budget breakdown, but it leaves out any delivery date or refund promise, doesn't mention that the ratings came mostly from people who played at the creator's table, and still has [Game Title] and [Your name] placeholders, which makes a first-time creator look less trustworthy.
